abstract: OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the outcome in a cohort of fetuses with isolated sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT) in relation to the need for in utero intervention. METHODS: We retrospectively analyzed a cohort of fetuses prenatally diagnosed with SCT between September 2000 and December 2010. Postnatal outcomes were evaluated in relation to the need for intervention in utero by reviewing medical records. RESULTS: Of the 35 fetuses diagnosed with SCT during the study period, ten were lost to follow up and three had been misdiagnosed as SCT. Among the remaining 22 cases, in utero interventions were performed in eight, including radiofrequency ablation (RFA) in four, shunt operations in two, RFA plus cyst aspiration in one, and RFA with subsequent shunt operation in one. Tumors of cases undergoing in utero intervention were larger with rapidly growing, more frequently vascular, and with associated polyhydramnios or cardiomegaly. The rate of preterm births was higher in the cases that underwent interventions compared with those that did not (7/8 vs 2/14). Only one tumor showed regression after RFA while the other seven increased in size. Median tumor size at birth was significantly larger in the intervention group than in the nonintervention group (136 mm vs 80 mm). The neonatal survival rate was 6/8 for the prenatal intervention group and 14/14 for the nonintervention group. Resection of SCT was required in all neonates. The most common complication after postnatal surgery was fecal incontinence. CONCLUSION: Fetuses with SCT undergoing in utero intervention have worse prognostic features, yet their neonatal outcome is similar to those of fetuses not requiring intervention.
abstract_ja:
目的：胎内治療の必要性との関連から、孤立性仙尾部奇形腫（SCT）を有する胎児のコホートにおける転帰を評価すること。
方法：2000年9月から2010年12月に出生前にSCTと診断された胎児のコホートを後方視的に解析した。出生後の転帰は、胎内治療の必要性との関連で診療録の確認により評価した。
結果：この期間にSCTと診断された35例の胎児のうち、10例はフォローアップ不能、3例はSCTと誤診されていた。残りの22例のうち、8例で胎内治療を行った。内訳は、ラジオ波焼灼術（RFA）4例、シャント術2例、RFAと嚢胞穿刺1例、RFAに続くシャント術1例であった。胎内治療を受けた症例の腫瘍は、より大きく、急速に増大し、より血管に富み、羊水過多や心拡大を伴うことが多かった。早産率は治療群の方が高かった（7/8 vs 2/14）。RFA後に腫瘍が縮小したのは1例のみで、他の7例は増大した。出生時の腫瘍の中央値は、治療群で非治療群より有意に大きかった（136mm vs 80mm）。新生児生存率は、胎内治療群で6/8、非治療群で14/14であった。全新生児でSCTの切除が必要であった。出生後手術後の最も多い合併症は便失禁であった。
結論：胎内治療を受けたSCT胎児は予後不良因子を有するが、新生児転帰は治療を要しなかった胎児と同様であった。
